 RELEASE: Blackhawks Recall Dillion Boucher From Rockford, Place Bowen Byram on Injured Reserve
 Boucher will look to make his NHL debut and Byram moves to injured reserve retroactive to Oct. 15
 By 
 Chicago Blackhawks Communications 
 Blackhawks.com 
 November 03, 2026 
 Link copied 
 The Chicago Blackhawks today announced that forward Dillon Boucher has been recalled from the Rockford IceHogs of the American Hockey League (AHL). Additionally, defenseman Bowen Byram (upper body) has been placed on injured reserve retroactive to Oct. 15.
Boucher, 29, has skated in seven games with the IceHogs during the 2026-27 campaign.
The Blackhawks play the Florida Panthers on Wednesday, Nov. 4 at Amerant Bank Arena at 7:30 p.m. ET/6:30 p.m. CT. The game can be seen nationally on TNT and heard on WGN Radio.
